_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); paint and coatings signals

classification.quality_note: Sherwin-Williams: 'engaged in the development, manufacture, distribution and sale of paint, coatings and related products to professional, industrial, commercial and retail customers primarily in North and South America'; 'We are a leading manufacturer and retailer of paint, coatings and related products to professional, industrial, commercial and retail customers'; its Paint Stores Group 'consisted of 3,325 company-operated specialty paint stores'; and 'Portions of our business involve the sale of paint, coatings and related products to segments of the economy that are cyclical in nature, particularly segments relating to construction, housing and manufacturing' (its own FY2007 10-K): a store-network franchise whose demand follows construction and housing by its own account; the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 0.67x; +8% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.77; conservative 2yr +8%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -11.6%/yr (worst year FY98-FY07, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +3.1%/yr (Q1 ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +13.0%/yr (FY98-FY07 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +24.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY98-FY07); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: SHW (retrospective, 2008-06-20) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.67x (29.9% downside to Bear $35 / +44.3% upside to Bull $72) | Adj composite 1.76 vs market 2.53: gap -0.77 [OVERVALUED] | +8% above the EPP floor $46 (12x FY08E $3.85) | Conservative 2-yr case: +8.2% total (+4.1%/yr) | At 13.0x FY08E the 15% hurdle price $66 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; comps -6.5% in Q1 2008, forward sales -0.1% (no FY08 net sales guide in numbers, Q1 2008 net sales ex-currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
